GeneratedDocument.title: Generated document
GeneratedDocument.description: The humaniq-side record of one attempt to render a standard HR document (arbeidsovereenkomst, aanbiedingsbrief, werkgeversverklaring, getuigschrift, loonstrook, jaaropgaaf) via docudesk's template/rendering engine and store the returned PDF (humaniq-docudesk-documents, extended by payslip-pdf-docudesk). Humaniq owns no template or PDF machinery of its own (design.md D1): this schema is a log of the handoff. Which template, for whom, the outcome, and where the file landed. Never the rendering itself. `skipped-no-docudesk` and `failed` are retryable outcomes: a later `occ humaniq:documents:generate` invocation (or the EmploymentContractDetail/PayslipDetail page action) can supersede them (design.md D6). At most one GeneratedDocument per idempotency key may be `pending`/`generated` at a time: the four letter types key on (contractId|employeeId, documentType), loonstrook keys on (payslipId, documentType), jaaropgaaf keys on (jaaropgaafId, documentType). Enforced by HrDocumentService and audited by the nl-contract-schriftelijk / nl-loonstrook-verplicht corpus rules.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.x-notes: Which standard HR document this record represents. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not. loonstrook/jaaropgaaf added by payslip-pdf-docudesk.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: Reference to the Employee this document is for.

contractId.title: Contract
contractId.description: The contract this document evidences. Required for an employment contract; leave empty for documents about the person rather than the contract.
contractId.x-notes: Reference to the EmploymentContract this document evidences -- required in practice for arbeidsovereenkomst; null for employee-level document types (aanbiedingsbrief/werkgeversverklaring/getuigschrift/loonstrook/jaaropgaaf).

payslipId.title: Payslip
payslipId.description: The payslip this document renders. Only for a payslip document.
payslipId.x-notes: Reference to the Payslip this loonstrook document renders (payslip-pdf-docudesk) -- set only on documentType: loonstrook; null on every other type.

jaaropgaafId.title: Annual statement
jaaropgaafId.description: The annual statement this document renders. Only for an annual statement.
jaaropgaafId.x-notes: Reference to the Jaaropgaaf annual aggregate this document renders (payslip-pdf-docudesk) -- set only on documentType: jaaropgaaf; null on every other type.

templateRef.title: Template
templateRef.description: The template used to produce this document.
templateRef.x-notes: The docudesk template UUID actually used to render this document -- plain string, NOT $ref, because it targets another app's register (ADR-062 rule 7: only fields whose target exists in this register set get $ref).

status.title: Status
status.description: How this generation attempt ended. A failed or skipped attempt is replaced by a retry.
status.x-notes: Outcome of this generation attempt. failed/skipped-no-docudesk are superseded by a retry; only one pending/generated record may exist per (contract|employee, documentType).

filePath.title: File path
filePath.description: Where the finished PDF is stored. Empty while it is still pending or the attempt failed.
filePath.x-notes: Path of the stored PDF in this object's own OpenRegister folder (written via FileService::addFile), or null while pending/failed/skipped.

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Why it failed or was skipped, for example a missing template or storage problem.
errorMessage.x-notes: Failure or skip diagnostic (e.g. docudesk unavailable, ambiguous/missing template, storage failure).

generatedAt.title: Generated at
generatedAt.description: When the PDF was produced and filed.
generatedAt.x-notes: When the PDF was produced by docudesk and stored on this object's folder.

Jaaropgaaf.title: Annual statement
Jaaropgaaf.description: The per-employee-per-year annual-statement aggregate (payslip-pdf-docudesk design.md D2): totals derived exclusively from the employee's Payslips for the given year. Never fabricated, never containing figures no Payslip field carries. Created and updated exclusively by HrDocumentService's aggregation step, upserted per (employeeId, year): re-aggregating refreshes an existing object's totals and `aggregatedAt` rather than creating a duplicate. Carries no status/lifecycle. Render state lives on the GeneratedDocument that renders it (D1).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Who this annual statement is for.
employeeId.x-notes: Reference to the Employee this annual statement is for.

year.title: Year
year.description: The kalenderjaar this annual statement aggregates.

totalGrossPay.title: Total gross pay
totalGrossPay.description: Total gross pay over the year: the 'loon' line on the annual statement.
totalGrossPay.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.grossPay across the year's payslips (the jaaropgaaf 'loon' column).

totalLoonheffing.title: Total loonheffing
totalLoonheffing.description: Total payroll tax withheld over the year.
totalLoonheffing.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.loonheffing across the year's payslips.

totalNettoPay.title: Total net pay
totalNettoPay.description: Total net pay over the year.
totalNettoPay.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.nettoPay across the year's payslips.

totalZvwWithheld.title: Total Zvw withheld
totalZvwWithheld.description: Total health insurance contribution withheld from the employee over the year. The employer levy is not part of this.
totalZvwWithheld.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.zvw ONLY where zvwMode == 'inhouding' -- the employer levy (werkgeversheffing) is never a werknemersaandeel and is excluded from this sum.

totalPensionContribution.title: Total pension contribution
totalPensionContribution.description: Total pension contribution over the year.
totalPensionContribution.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.pensionContribution across the year's payslips.

totalVakantiegeldReserved.title: Total vakantiegeld reserved
totalVakantiegeldReserved.description: Total holiday allowance set aside over the year: what was reserved, not what was paid out.
totalVakantiegeldReserved.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.vakantiegeldReserved across the year's payslips -- the reservation, not the payout.

payPeriodCount.title: Pay period count
payPeriodCount.description: Number of payslips aggregated into this jaaropgaaf.

verrekendeArbeidskorting.title: Employment tax credit applied
verrekendeArbeidskorting.description: The employment tax credit applied over the year. Stays empty until payroll records it: better empty than a made-up zero.
verrekendeArbeidskorting.x-notes: Statutory jaaropgaaf line for the applied arbeidskorting -- stays null because no Payslip field carries arbeidskorting today (a payroll-core follow-up); never a fabricated 0.00 presented as fact.

loonheffingennummer.title: Payroll tax number
loonheffingennummer.description: The employer's payroll tax number, taken from the settings when this statement was produced.
loonheffingennummer.x-notes: Employer loonheffingennummer, snapshotted from configuration at aggregation time.

aggregatedAt.title: Aggregated at
aggregatedAt.description: When the aggregation last ran: refreshed on every upsert.

objects.errorMessage: Docudesk was niet geïnstalleerd op het moment van deze poging; opnieuw proberen zodra docudesk beschikbaar is.
